messages:
anya: FYI route `widget-payments` hit quota and sampler dropped captures. We lost traces for a customer session. Any ideas beyond simple rate limits?
ops-bot: ALERT: route=widget-payments request_log_ingest=19500/min threshold=8000 at 2026-04-05T09:12:34Z
ben: saw it. Global cap is too noisy for bursty billing jobs. Proposal: introduce a 'sample escrow' (aka exposure_budget) per route that accrues credits during idle periods and can be spent for short diagnostic windows.
owen: sample escrow sounds promising. We must pair it with a privacy budget: exposure_budget measured in expected pii_tokens allowed to be exposed. That prevents unlimited blind captures.
kira: UX: console should show "exposure budget remaining" with a warn color when <20%. Also an action to spend X minutes of budget with required justification.
anya: sketch of policy shape:
```
{
  "route":"widget-payments",
  "exposure_budget_tokens": 10000,   // tokens allowed to be exposed
  "recharge_rate_tokens_per_min": 50,
  "max_burst_minutes": 30,
  "redaction_profile":"mask_v2",
  "inspect_policy":"ephemeral_strict|ephemeral_relaxed|persistent_op" 
}
```
sam: important: any spend must emit a security-audit event and increase telemetry metric `exposure_spent` with fields (actor, route, before, after, ticket). No silent spends.
ben: telemetry change: estimate_exposed_tokens = sample_fraction * observed_tokens_likely_pii. We can compute delta on hypothetical changes for console preview. Show delta_estimate before approving a spend.
owen: enforcement: if exposure_budget would go negative, deny request and suggest alternatives (isolate route, enable aggregated diagnostics).
kira: console action flow: click "Open diagnostic window" -> preview shows estimated_exposure_delta and redaction_confidence histogram -> require reason + ticket link -> 2FA confirm if delta > 5000 tokens.
anya: implementation detail: request-logger API v3 will accept `exposure_budget_spend` payload. Example:
```
POST /internal/routes/widget-payments/spend
{ "minutes": 10, "profile": "ephemeral_relaxed", "reason": "investigate-failure", "ticket": "INC-7890" }
```
ops-bot: AUDIT: actor=anya action=spend_exposure route=widget-payments minutes=10 before=8432 after=7932 ticket=INC-7890 ts=2026-04-05T09:15:00Z
ben: privacy model: we already tag tokens with pii_score (0-1). redaction_confidence = 1 - avg(pii_score) for redaction heuristics? Maybe better: redaction_confidence = model_confidence that redaction removed all pii. Need experiments.
owen: for safety, any sampled payload with redaction_confidence < 0.7 should store only hashed placeholders, not raw masked text. That reduces leak risk during low-confidence redaction.
kira: UI: make the "privacy delta" tooltip explain: "estimated exposed tokens = pii_tokens * sample_frac; conservative upper bound shown". Also add link "How we compute this" leading to docs.
sam: ops question: who can spend exposure? Ops-only or tenant-level? I'd prefer ops-only but with allowlist for customer success for support cases. Gate via RBAC.
anya: canary/rollout plan: start with ops-only flag and 3 internal tenants as canary. Metric to watch: false_negative_redactions / 1k sampled_events. If that increases > 2x, rollback.
ben: telemetry alert rule: if exposure_spent increases >50% over baseline and redaction_confidence_mean drops by >0.1 in 10m, create high-severity alert.
owen: finally, CLI snippet for emergency isolated captures: 
```
ri ops spend-exposure --route=widget-payments --minutes=5 --profile=ephemeral_strict --ticket=INC-7890 --reason="hotfix" --require-2fa
```
kira: I'll mock the panel with budget ring, preview delta, and 2FA modal. Will post Figma in 24h.
sam: owners: ben -> telemetry and metrics, anya -> request-logger API & enforcement, kira -> console mock, owen -> rollout gating and RBAC.
anya: thanks all. Sync tomorrow 11 to review API contract and telemetry field names. Closing: ensure every spend writes immutable audit and surfaces in security-audit feed. :lock:
